comments.author: greptile
comments.body:
**Concurrent archive can be overwritten**

If the filesystem does not support hard links and two backups use the same explicit `--out` path, both can pass the existence check before either publishes. The second `os.replace` then overwrites the first archive, despite the promise that existing backups are never replaced. The concurrency test covers distinct generated filenames, not this fallback.
comments.title: Concurrent archive can be overwritten

comments.author: greptile
comments.body:
**Ambiguous source selects a file**

If several indexed files share a basename or relative suffix and one is under the server’s working directory, `_exact_candidates` turns that file’s `realpath` into an exact match. `read` or `file_context` then returns that file instead of reporting `ambiguous_source`, so a caller can receive the wrong source content. The ambiguity tests do not cover a matching file under the working directory.
comments.title: Ambiguous source selects a file

comments.author: greptile
comments.body:
**File context stops at 10,000**

For a source with more than 10,000 indexed chunks, this fetch never requests the remaining rows. `file_context` therefore reports a capped `total` and eventually returns a null `next_offset` while chunks remain, making them unreachable through pagination. The paging test indexes only five chunks and does not cover this limit.
comments.title: File context stops at 10,000
